caption:
🌡️⚡ Fever… then a fit? Stay calm. Here's exactly what to do.

✅ About 1 in 30 young children (6 months to 5 years) have a fever fit. Most stop within 5 minutes.

🟢 During a fit, do this:
1️⃣ Stay calm and note the time
2️⃣ Lay your child on their side, on the floor
3️⃣ Loosen clothes, move hard things away
4️⃣ Stay with them until they wake
5️⃣ Call an ambulance if it lasts over 5 minutes

❌ Please don't:
• Put anything in the mouth
• Hold them down
• Give water or medicine during the fit
• Put them in cold water

🚨 Go to hospital NOW if:
• The fit lasts more than 5 minutes
• Another fit within 24 hours
• Only one side of the body jerks
• Not waking up fully afterwards
• Stiff neck, rash or very sleepy
• Child under 6 months

💊 Fever medicine does NOT prevent fits. It helps comfort: give it as your doctor advises.
